notes.subject: to Yisrael
notes.rationale: 'Yu no ken pret' — Yahwe i tok stret long Yisrael.

notes.subject: ol pikinini bilong yu
notes.rationale: זרעך em i 'pikinini bilong yu' — tok bilong olgeta lain i kamap long yu, i no 'sidin'.

notes.subject: ממזרח/וממערב
notes.rationale: San i kamap na san i go daun — tupela sait i putim stret long kalik, Tok Pisin i holim piksa bilong san.

translation: Yu no ken pret, bilong ⟨את⟩ mi yet i stap wantaim yu: long sais ist bilong san i kamap, bai mi bringim ⟨את⟩ ol pikinini bilong yu, na long sais wes bilong san i go daun, bai mi kolim yu olgeta i kam bek.
